top_signals.title: Big Tech Rally Extends Into Fourth Week as AI Bubble Fears Fade
top_signals.summary: US stocks ended the week inches away from record highs as investors brushed aside concerns around the artificial-intelligence spending spree and an energy crunch to prepare for the start of earnings season.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
